explanation:
The central tree retains all seven major responsibilities while shrinking from 6,334 to 4,294 characters (32.2%) and from 94 to 62 lines (34.0%). Six peripherals expand input contracts, execution, state ownership, experiments, comparison evidence and publication. Modular boundaries identify public operations and private state; call sequences show execution; ownership describes retained records and resource lifetimes; data dependencies connect pinned inputs to outputs and assessments. Edges attach to the relevant concept lines. Positions use measured text dimensions, with at least eight columns between diagram columns and four blank rows between stacked trees.

Corrections and qualifications from the pinned sources: evalPromptService.ts:131-165 appends a version when stages/template base change or explicit parents are supplied; name/description-only edits retain versions. evalRunService.ts:654-668 retries validation failures, while runtime.generate errors propagate. compareSessionService.ts:96-124 permits retained generated checkpoints even when they are not the current workspace head; copyCompareHistory preserves an endpoint and rendering dependencies, not the undo archive. evalRunService.ts:327-337 marks diagram-history cells cancelled without calling an external coordinator abort operation, so cancellation is not universally an execution abort. AgentContextEvalRuntime's cleanup is in its generation try/finally; the seed's claim of disposal on every exit is broader than that protected scope.

Details added beyond the seed include prompt merge constraints and cross-workflow lineage, prompt catalog snapshots, context ownership for canvas-only workflows, private experiment launch receipts, comparison deduplication and revision boundaries, deletion scope differences, and historical placement backfill. These come from the supplied EvalPromptService, EvalRunService, ExperimentService, CompareSessionService, JudgementService and evalRun domain definitions. EvalsPage supports the retained product surface. Imported runtime, materializer, catalog and external coordinator implementations were not supplied; their internal behavior is not inferred. prepareForReview avoids model execution but can create an owning context or a template during preparation.

diagrams.ascii:
Generation Evaluation Workbench
|-- Product surface: EvalsPage
|   |-- Edit prompts, capture references and manage layout templates
|   |-- Launch runs; browse experiments, samples and stage outputs
|   `-- Select outputs -> compare side by side -> inspect judgements
|-- Pin run meaning: EvalPromptService + EvalRunService
|   |-- Prompt version -> stage text, hash, lineage and cited reference text
|   |   `-- Version content changes append history; reject stale base versions
|   |-- AgentContext -> saved identity and hash, checked before execution
|   |-- Canvas inputs -> independent checkpoint copies via CompareSessionService
|   |   `-- Pin applicable prior alternatives, canvas sets and layout templates
|   |-- Request -> workflow, model, effort, prompt versions and samples
|   |   `-- Same request ID with different content -> conflict
|   `-- Rerun -> matching pinned inputs/prompts; original root and context owner
|-- Execute and retain evidence: EvalRunService
|   |-- Ordinary cells = prompts x samples x workflow stages
|   |   |-- Persist queued run before launch; bound sample-chain concurrency
|   |   `-- Default concurrency 3; session context serializes chains within a run
|   |-- Workflow dispatch
|   |   |-- alternatives -> generated diagrams, optionally in pinned template slots
|   |   |-- diagram-change-proposal -> exact tree plus display canvas
|   |   |   `-- Preserve tree syntax errors for deterministic assessment
|   |   |-- linked-canvases -> frozen multi-canvas bundle under one cell
|   |   |-- roll-up -> r2 result -> g2 attachment to pinned parent
|   |   |   `-- r2 failure -> skip g2
|   |   |-- few-shot-refinement -> dedicated executor; three rounds
|   |   `-- diagram-history -> external coordinator; timeline-step references
|   |-- EvalRuntime boundary -> AgentContextEvalRuntime
|   |   |-- No agentContext supplied -> delegate to CodexEvalRuntime
|   |   `-- Session context -> independent session, shared prefix cache key
|   |-- Output validation -> at most 3 generation attempts
|   |   `-- Validation failure adds prior output/error; runtime errors propagate
|   |-- Output evidence -> checkpoint snapshots, usage and execution provenance
|   |   `-- External change-session result -> pin once without acceptance/generation
|   `-- Lifecycle -> serialized saves, cell-derived status, cancellation/deletion
|       `-- Restart fails interrupted ordinary cells; completed outputs survive
|-- Controlled trials: ExperimentService
|   |-- Conditions, cases and phases -> samples, attempts and run/cell references
|   |-- prepareForReview -> freeze prompts/inputs without calling a model
|   |   `-- Every planned cell maps exactly once to a sample stage
|   |-- Recorded approval -> launchPrepared -> attach cells to samples
|   |   `-- Retain launch progress; approved plans and inputs cannot be reassigned
|   |-- Edited relaunch -> fork prompt, new run and incremented attempt
|   `-- Phase comparison -> deterministic judgement of finished proposal trees
|-- Independent comparisons: CompareSessionService
|   |-- Source = document, optional view and checkpoint; reject stale selections
|   |-- copyCompareHistory -> selected endpoint plus rendering revisions
|   |   `-- Deep copy, fresh history context, empty undo/redo stacks
|   `-- createPinned -> A/B canvas or diagram pairs validated against snapshots
|       `-- Independent cameras or exact diagram revision, ranges and subtree
|-- Typed assessments: JudgementService
|   |-- Reconcile comparisons -> canvas-comparison, diagram-comparison or report
|   |-- Native results -> few-shot-progress or diagram-change-tree
|   |-- Judgement owns subjects and attachments; may cover several runs
|   `-- Preserve evaluator, status and evidence; tombstones prevent recreation
`-- Promote completed outputs: EvalRunService -> project catalog
    |-- Finished cell -> timeline result, frozen bundle or canvas checkpoint
    |-- prepareOutputPromotion -> destination documents and optional new group
    |-- Existing canvas -> settled eligible target at expected revision
    |   `-- Reject unsaved workspace edits before publication
    `-- publishOutputPromotion -> receipt plus run/cell placement provenance
        `-- Matching request signature reuses receipt; conflicting reuse fails

Pinned inputs and prompt boundaries
|-- EvalPromptService exposes save / fork / resolve / snapshot
|   |-- Private write queue serializes mutations
|   |-- New version if stages or template base change, or parents supplied
|   |   `-- Name/description-only edits keep the version list
|   |-- Lineage traversal rejects cycles and missing parent versions
|   |   |-- Merge requires at least two parents
|   |   `-- History prompts may derive from diagram-change proposals
|   |-- resolve freezes cited name, ASCII and optional comment into run
|   `-- snapshot deep-copies the project's prompt catalog
|-- EvalRunService.prepare binds workflow inputs
|   |-- Reject missing/unknown bindings and duplicate canvas sources
|   |-- Context pin stores ID/name/hash; execution resolves source content
|   |-- Prior alternatives must share workflow and AgentContext
|   |-- Canvas-only workflow creates an owning AgentContext
|   `-- Reruns retain root ownership and reuse matching snapshots
`-- Request schema constrains supported combinations
    |-- 1-6 unique prompts; 1-20 samples
    |-- contextDelivery=session only for diagram-change-proposal
    `-- canvasSources only for linked-canvases

Generation calls and session lifetime
|-- EvalRunService.generateValidated
|   |-- Compose prompt -> EvalRuntime.generate -> validate/materialize
|   |-- Validation failure -> previous-output.json + validation-error.json
|   |   `-- Retry twice; runtime.generate rejection bypasses this retry
|   `-- Sum usage across attempts; return successful response execution ID
|-- AgentContextEvalRuntime.generate with agentContext
|   |-- Resolve messages and model before opening session
|   |-- Create independent persisted session; tools = []
|   |   `-- Disable context files, skills, extensions, retries and compaction
|   |-- Cache key hashes provider/model/effort/system prompt/context hash
|   |   `-- Shared prefix routing over SSE; distinct audit session IDs
|   |-- Prompt + serialized supplementary files -> assistant text
|   |   `-- Parse JSON if possible; otherwise return raw text for validation
|   |-- AbortSignal or generation timer -> session.abort()
|   `-- finally clears timer/listener, unsubscribes and disposes session
`-- No agentContext -> CodexEvalRuntime delegation
    `-- Its implementation is outside the supplied sources

Run state and deletion ownership
|-- EvalRunService retains private execution state
|   |-- running: AbortControllers; live: mutable executing runs
|   |-- Rename mutates live run so later progress keeps the name
|   |-- saves: per-run queue of cloned progress snapshots
|   `-- deleted: suppress future persistence after deletion
|-- runStatus precedence
|   |-- Generating cell -> generating
|   |-- Queued cells -> queued if all queued, otherwise generating
|   |-- All finished -> finished; some finished -> partial
|   `-- No finished: cancelled only with cancellation and no failure
|-- deleteRun -> selected run and its reruns
|   |-- Mark deleted, abort, drain writes, archive canvases, save tombstone
|   `-- A late generated canvas is archived if its run was deleted
|-- deleteRuns -> exactly selected IDs; other reruns stay
|-- deleteContextOutputs -> workflow outputs/comparisons; retain context
`-- diagram-history is a distinct coordinator boundary
    |-- Startup skips ordinary recovery for these runs
    `-- cancel marks pending cells cancelled; no coordinator abort call here

Experiment plans, launch receipts and assessment
|-- ExperimentService owns revisioned design and private launch records
|   |-- Public copies omit preparedRuns, receipts and startedRunIds
|   `-- Validate run/cell project, case context and optional pinned hash
|-- save -> EvalRunService.prepareForReview
|   |-- Store prepared runs and awaiting-approval review
|   `-- No runnable job/model call; preparation may create context/template
|-- approve -> persist approval and status=starting before launch
|   |-- launchPrepared each unstarted run; save each startedRunId
|   |-- Attach stage references -> status=started
|   `-- Matching receipt supports retry; changed approval conflicts
|-- relaunch -> validate edits -> reserve attempt receipt -> launchEdited
|   `-- Attempt increases within phase/case/condition/sample number
`-- judge -> select comparison phase/cases/conditions
    |-- Require finished cells with proposalTree, canvas and checkpoint
    |-- saveDeterministic -> attach judgement ID to comparison
    `-- A judgement cannot be housed in two experiments

Captured comparison evidence and judgement ownership
|-- CompareSessionService.capture
|   |-- Deduplicate document/view/checkpoint tuples
|   |-- Workspace sources must match current head or saved-view endpoint
|   `-- Generated source may supply a retained historical checkpoint
|-- copyCompareHistory
|   |-- Keep selected endpoint and required rendering revisions only
|   |-- Remove checkpoint parent/transaction; reset undo and redo
|   `-- Record revision boundaries; deep-copy and validate history
|-- createPinned
|   |-- Clone captured copies before building stored pairs
|   |-- Diagram pairs validate revision, range bounds and subtree
|   `-- Canvas pairs own camera transforms and optional focus points
`-- JudgementService reconciles sessions/jobs with run identities
    |-- Subjects link captured sources to run IDs and cell keys
    |-- Typed comparisons keep only the canvas copies they use
    |-- Completed job without saved session -> failed comparison record
    |   `-- Experiment reports instead retain the job's status
    |-- Native progress/deterministic results use the same store
    `-- Delete writes tombstone; active comparison deletion calls executor

Output capture and catalog publication
|-- captureOutputResult serializes writes per run
|   |-- Same change-session ID/version -> return pinned summary
|   |-- Reject occupied cell, live/deleted run or cancelled/skipped cell
|   |-- Check session project, identity and expected version
|   `-- Store frozen result, finish cell and recompute run status
|-- promotionSource requires finished cell
|   `-- Timeline artifact -> frozen outputResults -> canvas checkpoint
|-- promoteOutput
|   |-- Hash run ID and request; check prior catalog promotion receipt
|   |-- Existing target must be settled, not generated/projection
|   |   `-- Match expected revision; check workspace name/document baseline
|   `-- prepare documents -> publishOutputPromotion with run/cell source
`-- backfillPlacementTracking repairs historical placement provenance
    |-- Whole-canvas promotion only; run must be finished
    |-- Require original promotion request signature and receipt
    `-- Backfill catalog lineage and missing frozen-result placement snapshot
